reviewer.independence_statement: This reviewer did not participate in model design, training, ranking, or Recall/MRR computation.

protocol.evidence_support: Adjudicated against the frozen CC BY Europe PMC manifest and its source-scoped excerpts.

protocol.final_label_rule: Where the independent reviewer disagreed with the source-scoped annotation, the more conservative source-bounded label was adopted and the disagreement was retained below.
protocol.metric_isolation: This record changes neither ranking outputs nor Recall/MRR. It only documents calibration-label review.
